1//! # signature-sdk
2//!
3//! Multi-language SDK for LSH (Locality-Sensitive Hashing) signature generation
4//! for AI prompt similarity detection.
5//!
6//! This crate provides the canonical Rust implementation of the signature-sdk algorithm,
7//! which is also available in Python and TypeScript.
8//!
9//! ## Quick Start
10//!
11//! ### High-Level API (Recommended)
12//!
13//! The easiest way to generate signatures is using `sign_text()`:
14//!
15//! ```rust,no_run
16//! # #[cfg(feature = "onnx")]
17//! # async fn example() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
18//! use odin_prompt_toolkit::{sign_text, SignatureVersion};
19//! use odin_prompt_toolkit::providers::{ModelCache, OnnxProvider};
20//!
21//! // Initialize ONNX provider (local, no API key needed)
22//! let cache = ModelCache::new()?;
23//! let provider = OnnxProvider::new(&cache, None, None).await?;
24//!
25//! // Generate signature from text
26//! let result = sign_text(
27//!     "How do I reset my password?",
28//!     SignatureVersion::V1,
29//!     Some(&provider),
30//!     None,
31//! ).await?;
32//!
33//! println!("Signature: {}", result.to_signature_string());
34//! // Output: "0din-v1:8d000000ac854dae..."
35//! # Ok(())
36//! # }
37//! ```
38//!
39//! ### Low-Level API (Manual Pipeline)
40//!
41//! For more control, use the composable primitives:
42//!
43//! ```rust,no_run
44//! # #[cfg(feature = "onnx")]
45//! # async fn example() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
46//! use odin_prompt_toolkit::{simhash_lsh_multi, LshConfig};
47//! use odin_prompt_toolkit::provider::EmbeddingProvider;
48//! use odin_prompt_toolkit::providers::{ModelCache, OnnxProvider};
49//!
50//! let cache = ModelCache::new()?;
51//! let provider = OnnxProvider::new(&cache, None, None).await?;
52//!
53//! // 1. Generate embedding
54//! let embedding = provider.generate_embedding("Hello, world!").await?;
55//!
56//! // 2. Compute LSH signatures (embedding is already normalized)
57//! let config = LshConfig::default();
58//! let families = simhash_lsh_multi(&embedding.normalized_embedding, &config);
59//!
60//! println!("Signature: {}", families[0].signature);
61//! # Ok(())
62//! # }
63//! ```
64//!
65//! ## Feature Flags
66//!
67//! | Feature | Default | Description |
68//! |---------|---------|-------------|
69//! | `openai` | Yes | OpenAI API embedding provider (V0 signatures, 1536 dims) |
70//! | `onnx` | Yes | Local ONNX embedding provider (V1 signatures, 1024 dims) |
71//! | `cm-lsh` | No | Confidence Matrix LSH (experimental, higher accuracy) |
72//!
73//! ## Signature Versions
74//!
75//! - **V0**: OpenAI text-embedding-3-large (1536 dimensions, API-based)
76//! - **V1**: 0din-jailbreak-embeddings-small ONNX (1024 dimensions, local)
77//! - **Latest**: Resolves to V1
78//!
79//! V0 and V1 signatures are **not comparable** due to different embedding spaces.
80//!
81//! ## Algorithm
82//!
83//! SimHash via Random Hyperplane LSH (Charikar 2002):
84//! - Deterministic hyperplanes via SplitMix64 PRNG
85//! - Default: 3 families × 256 bits × 16 bands
86//! - Hex-encoded signatures (64 hex chars = 256 bits)
87//! - Hamming distance → cosine similarity via `cos(π × d/n)`
88//!
89//! See the [specification](https://github.com/0din-ai/signature-sdk/blob/main/spec/SPEC.md)
90//! for complete algorithm details.
